description: 20 multi-turn agentic tool-loop tasks with tool fixtures and success criteria.

tasks.title: Read and summarize a source file
success_criteria: Returns a faithful summary of the target file's purpose
Cites at least two key symbols from the file

tasks.title: Search for a symbol across the crate
success_criteria: Locates all definitions of the queried symbol
Reports file paths and line numbers

tasks.title: Add a new FFI wrapper method
success_criteria: Method compiles without warnings
Existing tests still pass
New method is covered by a unit test

tasks.title: Update vendored MLX pin
success_criteria: PINS.md updated with new commit and digest
bindings.rs regenerated if API surface changed
Coverage inventory still green

tasks.title: Run the coverage inventory gate
success_criteria: --check passes with zero missing or stale symbols
--test rejects a mutated symbol

tasks.title: Regenerate bindings in the pinned container
success_criteria: Container regeneration completes without Clang errors
Checked-in bindings match container output byte-for-byte

tasks.title: Run the reproducibility check
success_criteria: Two clean builds produce identical library hashes
Hashes recorded in DR-0001

tasks.title: Verify pinned vendor tree digests
success_criteria: All five trees match PINS.md and .sha256 mirrors
Tampering with any tree is rejected

tasks.title: Add a new benchmark scenario
success_criteria: Scenario JSON validates against manifest.schema.json
Scenario count matches manifest declaration
validate.sh passes

tasks.title: Resolve and record a model artifact hash
success_criteria: Model file downloaded and hashed
models.json updated with verified sha256
manifest.json models.sha256 updated

tasks.title: Create a GitHub release tag
success_criteria: Tag points to a clean main commit
Release notes summarize Phase 0 status

tasks.title: Reserve crate name alloyd on crates.io
success_criteria: Placeholder 0.0.0 publication succeeds
Name reserved for future alloyd releases

tasks.title: Reserve package name alloyml on npm
success_criteria: Placeholder 0.0.0 publication succeeds
Name reserved for future alloyml releases

tasks.title: Reserve package name alloy-convert on PyPI
success_criteria: Placeholder 0.0.0 publication succeeds
Name reserved for future alloy-convert releases

tasks.title: Create the homebrew-alloy tap
success_criteria: Tap repo contains Formula/alloy.rb stub
Tap is installable via brew tap

tasks.title: Write the Phase 1 execution plan
success_criteria: PHASE-1-EXECUTION-PLAN.md contains exact file set and named tests
Plan reviewed against Phase 1 exit criteria

tasks.title: Add CI workflow for Linux and Mac lanes
success_criteria: Linux lane runs on every PR
Mac lane runs on merge-to-main and release tags
Tests 8, 9, 12 pass in CI

tasks.title: Document the fallback decision for mlx-c binding layer
success_criteria: DR-0001 records own-layer vs mlx-c-rust outcome
Decision boundary documented for infra-crate API

tasks.title: Run the full Phase 0 named test suite locally
success_criteria: Tests 1-7 pass on macOS
Tests 8, 9, 12 pass
Test 6 skips cleanly on hosts without Metal

tasks.title: Freeze the benchmark corpus
success_criteria: All scenario files populated with exact counts
All fixture hashes recorded
freeze.date set in manifest.json
